package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation;

/**
 * Thrown when a create request supplies a lastName and address already used together by
 * another owner (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) and the request
 * does not opt in via {@code sharesHousehold}. Handled by
 * {@link DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler}, which responds 409.
 */
public class DuplicateHouseholdException extends Exception {

    public DuplicateHouseholdException(String lastName, String address) {
        super("An owner with this last name already lives at this address: " + lastName + ", " + address);
    }
}

content.content:
- name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (they share a household). Request-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

## Summary

Implemented the rule: **creating an owner is rejected with 409 when the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.**

Following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, I added a new guard step to the `POST /api/owners` pipeline, modeled on the existing `EnsureUniqueHousehold` / `EnsureUniqueTelephone` steps:

1. **`EnsureCityCapacity`** (`.../function/owner/EnsureCityCapacity.java`) — counts existing owners whose city matches the request's city (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed, consistent with the other rules) and throws a checked `CityAtCapacityException` when the count is ≥ 50.

2. **`CityAtCapacityException`** (`.../escalation/`) — checked exception so it surfaces in the `throws` clause.

3. **`CityAtCapacityExceptionHandler`** (`.../escalation/`) — responds `409 Conflict` with a `ProblemDetail` body, matching the existing duplicate-household/telephone handlers.

4. **Escalation YAML** (`officefloor/escalation/...CityAtCapacityException.yml`) — wires the exception to its handler.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `ensureCityCapacity` step (governed by `transaction`) between `ensureUniqueHousehold` and `build`.

Verified: `Cp18Tests` (fill a city to 50, 51st rejected as 409) passes, and no existing test regressed.
